rules: Always exclude cancelled documents: T0."CANCELED" = 'N' on OINV, ORIN, OPCH, ORPC, ORDR, OPOR, OPDN, OPRQ, OIGE, OIGN.
Sales = A/R invoices (OINV + INV1) MINUS A/R credit memos (ORIN + RIN1): combine with UNION ALL and make credit memo amounts negative.
Purchases = A/P invoices (OPCH + PCH1) MINUS A/P credit memos (ORPC + RPC1).
Net sales amount in INR = SUM(LineTotal); apply header discount with LineTotal - LineTotal * DiscPrcnt / 100 when asked for net.
Financial year starts on 1 April: FY = CASE WHEN MONTH(date) >= 4 THEN YEAR(date) ELSE YEAR(date) - 1 END; FY month number = CASE WHEN MONTH(date) >= 4 THEN MONTH(date) - 3 ELSE MONTH(date) + 9 END.
Export customers have OCRD.GroupCode = '100' and foreign currency (DocCur <> 'INR'); everything else is domestic. Foreign amounts are in DocTotalFC / TotalFrgn.
Open orders: header DocStatus = 'O' and line LineStatus = 'O' (or OpenQty > 0).
Current stock per warehouse is OITW.OnHand; stock valuation / ledger comes from OINM: SUM(InQty - OutQty) and SUM(TransValue) with DocDate <= the as-on date.

Document chain uses BaseType / BaseEntry / BaseLine: purchase request (1470000113) > purchase order (22) > GRPO (20) > A/P invoice (18); sales order (17) > delivery (15) > A/R invoice (13); production order = 202.
Item group names come from OITB joined on ItmsGrpCod; business partner group names from OCRG joined on GroupCode.
Month and year filters: use YEAR(date) = ... and MONTH(date) = ...; 'today' = CURRENT_DATE; 'last 30 days' = date >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -30).
